sources.snippet: See Benchmarking DeepSeek-V4-Flash for the full results. Background DeepSeek-V4-Flash is a 284 billion parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model from DeepSeek-AI, with only 13 billion parameters active per forward pass.
